About ECOM AE

Built by Electronic World Group in Dubai — one cloud for commerce, ERP, CRM, and UAE e-invoicing.

Who we are

ECOM AE is the hosted operator platform behind live tenants including eParts Cart, Taxofinca, Electronicae, Stylenlook, and The Jewellery Trend. We provision isolated MySQL databases, industry themes, and Super CP onboarding so agencies go live in as little as 24 hours after DNS.

  • Multi-tenant Model C — one nginx docroot, hostname routing
  • Super CP (operator control panel) at ecomae.com/cp
  • Client CP and storefront on each client domain
  • Peppol / PINT-AE e-invoice in ERP Finance

Electronic World Group

Dubai, UAE · B2B SaaS and commerce infrastructure for the GCC.

Contact us Customer results

Phase 1 — read-only

API documentation

Integrate your ERP, BI, or middleware with ECOM AE tenant data via JSON REST. Phase 1 covers health checks, catalogue search, orders, and ERP KPIs — authenticated per tenant with API keys issued from Super CP.

OpenAPI JSON API health 3-day demo

Why integrate?

Connect warehouse systems, accounting exports, partner portals, or custom dashboards without scraping the storefront. Each tenant receives isolated API keys scoped to their MySQL database — orders and ERP figures never cross tenants.

Phase 1 endpoints

Method Path Auth Description
GET /epc-api/v1/health None Platform API status and endpoint list
GET /epc-api/v1/capabilities None Capability area summary from marketing catalog
GET /epc-api/v1/openapi.json None Machine-readable OpenAPI 3 spec
GET /epc-api/v1/tenant/info X-API-Key Tenant name, industry, access mode
GET /epc-api/v1/orders X-API-Key Recent shop orders (limit 20)
GET /epc-api/v1/products/search?q= X-API-Key Search published catalogue products
GET /epc-api/v1/erp/dashboard-summary X-API-Key ERP KPI summary (read-only)

Authentication

API key header

  1. Request enterprise API access via contact or your 3-day demo onboarding.
  2. Platform operator issues a tenant-scoped key from Super CP (stored as SHA-256 hash only).
  3. Send the key on every authenticated request: X-API-Key: your_key_here
  4. Keys include read scopes: tenant info, orders, products, ERP dashboard.

Example curl (safe placeholders)

# Public health — no key
curl -s https://www.ecomae.com/epc-api/v1/health

# Tenant info — replace placeholder
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_YOUR_TENANT_read_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" \
  https://www.ecomae.com/epc-api/v1/tenant/info

# Product search
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_YOUR_TENANT_read_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" \
  "https://www.ecomae.com/epc-api/v1/products/search?q=brake"

Never commit real keys to source control or public pages.

Existing integrations scope

Public REST API (Phase 1)

JSON at /epc-api/v1/ — designed for external systems, BI, and partner integrations with API keys.

ERP ajax (internal)

CP session endpoints under /cp/shop/finance/erp/ajax_* require staff login — not exposed as public API.

Future scope

  • Webhooks — order placed, stock low, lead captured
  • E-invoice submit — Peppol / PINT-AE outbound
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 sync
  • Marketplace channel write-back
  • Write APIs v2 — create orders, update stock, post invoices

Need API keys for production?

Enterprise tenants receive scoped keys after onboarding. Start with a 3-day demo or contact sales for API access on your live tenant.

Contact for API keys Book demo Download OpenAPI

For your own website — not a tenant

Autoparts Catalog & Price PRO API

Offer vehicle spare-parts lookup on your site without renting a full ECOM AE storefront or ERP. Choose Catalog API (vehicle & parts catalog data), Price PRO API (live supplier price & availability), or both — we issue client keys and document integration for your developers.

Request API access Catalog API Price PRO

Who this is for

These products are for integration partners — independent websites, marketplaces, garage portals, and apps that need catalog or price data only. They are not the same as a monthly tenant (storefront + CP + ERP) or ERP-only client access.

Catalog customer

JSON REST for manufacturers → models → categories → articles, VIN decode, engine search, analogs. Powered by the Epart vehicle catalog service. Embed in your UX with your branding.

Price PRO customer

Article + brand → supplier offers, stock hints, and list prices from connected price feeds. For B2B portals and comparison widgets on third-party sites.

Not a tenant

No CP login, no shop checkout, no full ERP. Need orders, inventory, and UAE e-invoice? See tenant plans or Tenant ERP API.

Autoparts Catalog API

Vehicle-aware spare parts catalog (Epart catalog API). Your server or front-end calls our gateway; we handle upstream catalog keys, caching, and daily quotas.

Query param action Purpose
manufacturers List vehicle manufacturers (passenger, commercial, motorbike)
models Models for a manufacturer
modifications Engine / trim variants for a model
categories Part categories for a vehicle modification
products Products in a category
articles Articles in a category
article Single article detail by brand + number
analogs Cross-reference / analog parts
brands Aftermarket brands list
vin VIN decode → vehicle + applicable catalog tree
engines Engine code lookup
engine_search Search engines by code fragment
status Connection status and daily quota usage

Base URL (keys issued on onboarding)

After onboarding you receive an X-API-Key (prefix epc_catalog_…) and daily quota. Public entry point:

GET https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/catalog.php?action=manufacturers&section=passenger
Header: X-API-Key: epc_catalog_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY

Hosted ECOM AE storefronts use the built-in catalog widget on your domain. Third-party sites and apps should call /api/v1/catalog.php only.

Example integration flow

  1. User picks manufacturer → your site calls action=models&manufacturer_id=…
  2. User picks model → action=modifications
  3. User browses category tree → categories, then articles or products
  4. Optional VIN tab → action=vin&vin=… or engine code → engine_search
# Manufacturers (passenger cars) — replace YOUR_CLIENT_KEY after onboarding
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_catalog_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY" \
  "https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/catalog.php?action=manufacturers&section=passenger"

# VIN decode
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_catalog_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY" \
  "https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/catalog.php?action=vin&vin=WBAXG1103CDW29096"

# Quota / status (includes api_client.remaining when authenticated)
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_catalog_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY" \
  "https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/catalog.php?action=status"

Spare Parts Price PRO API

Look up supplier list prices and availability for an article on a brand — designed for B2B widgets, garage systems, and marketplaces. Requires a Price PRO client key (separate from Catalog-only).

Price PRO endpoint (beta)

GET https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/price/lookup.php?brand=BOSCH&article=0986424590
Header: X-API-Key: epc_pricepro_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY

Response: { "ok": true, "beta": true, "offers": [ { "supplier", "price", "currency", "stock_hint" } ] }

Price PRO keys are issued on onboarding. Empty offers with a beta message means supplier feeds are not enabled yet — contact sales for enablement.

vs Catalog API

  • Catalog — vehicle tree, OEM categories, article metadata, VIN, analogs
  • Price PRO — commercial offers from connected supplier price files
  • Many clients start with Catalog only; add Price PRO when ready to show live buy prices
# Price PRO — supplier offers for brand + article
curl -s -H "X-API-Key: epc_pricepro_YOUR_CLIENT_KEY" \
  "https://www.ecomae.com/api/v1/price/lookup.php?brand=BOSCH&article=0986424590"

How integration works

1. Choose product

Catalog customer, Price PRO customer, or bundled. No tenant storefront required.

2. Receive credentials

We issue X-API-Key, daily quota, and allowed actions. Keys are hashed server-side; rotate on request.

3. Build on your site

Call JSON REST from your backend (recommended) or SPA with a thin proxy — never expose upstream catalog API keys in browser code.

4. Go live

Usage metering and support via ECOM AE. Upgrade to full tenant later if you need shop, CP, and ERP.

Related products

Tenant ERP API

For existing ECOM AE tenants: orders, shop products, ERP KPIs at /epc-api/v1/.

Full storefront tenant

Hosted shop + CP + ERP on your domain — see monthly plans.

Ecosystem structure

5 connected ecosystems for structured expansion

Designed as a disciplined operating model: each ecosystem has active industries today and expansion-ready industries on roadmap.

Commerce Ecosystem

Active industries

  • Auto parts commerce
  • Fashion e-commerce
  • Electronics retail
  • Medical supplies ordering

Expansion-ready roadmap

  • Hyperlocal grocery & FMCG
  • B2B wholesale marketplaces
  • Cross-border niche commerce

Business Services Ecosystem

Active industries

  • Tax advisory portals
  • Consultancy CRM + billing
  • ERP finance workflows

Expansion-ready roadmap

  • Legal/pro services operations
  • Corporate services onboarding
  • Managed back-office services

Lifestyle & Consumer Ecosystem

Active industries

  • Health & wellness commerce
  • Jewellery premium storefronts
  • Consumer engagement campaigns

Expansion-ready roadmap

  • Beauty & personal care subscriptions
  • Home & living curation
  • Experience-led consumer services

Asset & Sharing Economy

Active industries

  • Rental operations workflows
  • Multi-asset inventory controls
  • Deposit and contract tracking

Expansion-ready roadmap

  • Fleet sharing platforms
  • Equipment sharing networks
  • Property/service asset scheduling

Digital & Technology Ecosystem

Active industries

  • Super CP tenant orchestration
  • Client CP operations layer
  • Integrated ERP + CRM stack

Expansion-ready roadmap

  • API-led partner integrations
  • Intelligence automation services
  • Data products for operator decisions

Governance rule: Industries are added only when they increase transaction volume, platform dependency, or repeat usage.

Scale horizon: Now: active operations running across commerce, advisory, and tenantized CP/ERP delivery.
In 6 months: expand depth in each ecosystem with adjacent high-frequency workflows.
In 1-2 years: a connected ecosystem portfolio with shared data rails and repeat B2B/B2C cycles.

Positioning: ECOM AE is a structured multi-ecosystem platform, not a random listing site.
